summary: Schoolteacher's daughter of Unteribental who married J. G. Gremmelspacher in 1855; a namesake of, but not, John's 4th-great-grandmother.
bio:
Maria Anna Heitzler was born on 8 April 1813 at Unteribental, near Buchenbach in the Black Forest, the daughter of a schoolteacher. On 23 October 1855 she married the widower J. G. Gremmelspacher at Kirchzarten. He married again in 1863, so she must have died before then.

She shares a name and a birth year with John's 4th-great-grandmother, and it was once proposed that she was the widow of Servatius, but that identification has been disproven: she is a different woman.
